async def act(page):
    """
    Create a Catalog Price Rule for Pride Month: 45% off all products for all customers.

    Plan:
    - Use a relative goto to the Catalog Price Rule creation page (/index.php/admin/promo_catalog/new/).
    - Fill required visible fields using accessibility selectors (get_by_label / get_by_role).
    - Leave conditions blank so the rule applies to all products.
    - Click the Save button as the final action (it will navigate away).

    Notes:
    - I inspected the available knowledge_base functions and none were provided, so none are used.
    - All selectors use accessibility-focused methods (get_by_label, get_by_role) per instructions.
    """
    import asyncio

    # Navigate to the new Catalog Price Rule page (relative path)
    await page.goto("/index.php/admin/promo_catalog/new/")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")

    # Helpers that use accessibility-centric selectors only
    async def safe_fill_by_label(label_name: str, value: str) -> bool:
        el = page.get_by_label(label_name)
        if await el.count() > 0:
            await el.fill(value)
            return True
        # Fallback to textbox role with the same accessible name
        tb = page.get_by_role("textbox", name=label_name)
        if await tb.count() > 0:
            await tb.fill(value)
            return True
        return False

    async def safe_select_by_label(label_name: str, option_label: str) -> bool:
        sel = page.get_by_label(label_name)
        if await sel.count() > 0:
            try:
                await sel.select_option(label=option_label)
                return True
            except Exception:
                pass
        comb = page.get_by_role("combobox", name=label_name)
        if await comb.count() > 0:
            try:
                await comb.select_option(label=option_label)
                return True
            except Exception:
                pass
        return False

    # Fill main fields expected on the Catalog Price Rule page
    await safe_fill_by_label("Rule Name", "Pride Month - 45% Off")
    await safe_fill_by_label("Description", "45% off on all products during Pride Month for all customers.")

    # Set Status to Active (if available)
    await safe_select_by_label("Status", "Active")

    # Apply: percentage of original price
    await safe_select_by_label("Apply", "By Percentage of the Original Price")

    # Discount amount (percentage)
    await safe_fill_by_label("Discount Amount", "45")

    # Small pause to allow any dependent UI updates
    await asyncio.sleep(0.6)

    # Click Save — make this the last action because it will navigate away
    btn = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save Rule")
    if await btn.count() > 0:
        await btn.click()
        return

    btn2 = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save")
    if await btn2.count() > 0:
        await btn2.click()
        return

    # If no explicit "Save" button found by name, attempt to click the first button whose accessible name contains "Save"
    # (get_by_role uses substring matching by default for name, so try a more generic call)
    generic_save = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save")
    if await generic_save.count() > 0:
        await generic_save.nth(0).click()
        return

    # If still not found, give up (no further actions)
    return
